title: scRNA-seq, P01, before RTX treatment
extract_protocol_ch1: Frozen PBMC samples were thawed rapidly in trypsin-stopping solution (D-MEM Low Glucose, 10% FBS, and 1% penicillin/streptomycin) at 37°C, centrifuged at 400g for 10 minutes at 4°C and the supernatant was discarded. To release cell aggregation, 25 μL of DNase Booster Buffer and 10 μL of DNase I stock solution (#79254, QIAGEN) were added to the pellet and incubated at room temperature for 15 minutes. The samples were washed with trypsin-stopping solution and diluted with PBS. To isolate CD3+ T cells, PBMCs collected at both pre and post were stained and sorted at 4°C using pooled monoclonal antibodies and sorted using FACSAria Fusion flow cytometer (BD Biosciences).
Single-cell 5’ and TCR libraries were prepared following the protocol provided by the 10x Genomics Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’ Reagent Kits v2 (Dual Index).
data_processing: Droplet-based sequencing data were aligned and quantified using Cell Ranger 8.0.0(10x Genomics).
Assembly: Homo Sapiens, GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values files and matrix files
